findings: The area-weighted mean yield curve culminates at 3.599653 m3/ha/yr at age 100 on the CONTCLAS=C THLB proxy.
LTSY is 16,785.06 m3/yr, or 167,850.57 m3 per ten-year period. The x1.1 first guess is 184,635.63 m3, rounded to 185,000.
The sustained baseline meets the 185,000 m3 level target in 22 of 30 periods; the eight misses are 177,070-184,810 m3.
The 1,277,067 m3 growing-stock target at period 30 is the binding constraint: the baseline ends at 495,510.56 m3.
The even-flow -1 to 1 percent band is met in 4 of 30 periods because the baseline is flat in absolute volume but the final period is lower than the mean.
method: CMAI of the area-weighted mean yield curve x THLB area x period width x uplift
